- CAMP_MizorasPact_CFM.json: You enter the camp to find Mizora — a devil in human form — already waiting with her Arbiters (the Sisters of Justice, Feena and Cirrus) summoned from Baator to witness a bargain. Wyll is present and has just shared a memory of his father being taken from Wyrm’s Rock (Gortash is implicated), leaving him desperate to know where his father was sent. Mizora conjures Wyll’s glowing infernal contract (signed in blood) and offers a grim choice: Wyll may make a new pact with her to save his father, or refuse and risk his father’s death. The player briefly shares Wyll’s perspective through a parasite-linked memory, so both PC and Wyll are reacting to the same urgent, painful revelation.

context: Mizora — a devil who holds Wyll’s infernal pact — contacts the party after one of her assets, a powerful devil, was seized by Absolute’s cult and locked in Moonrise Towers. She manifests as a summoning/hologram in the camp and orders Wyll to retrieve the prisoner, invoking Clause Z to threaten that Wyll’s promised will be turned into a lemure in Avernus if he fails or refuses. Wyll is panicked (your minds briefly link), so the player can try to negotiate: demand Mizora release Wyll from his pact in exchange for rescuing her asset. Mizora grudgingly agrees to cooperate for the mission but only promises to amend the pact after it’s completed, not beforehand.
